The network, evidence, route conditions, coordinates, and lengths are entirely synthetic. Coordinates and lengths describe a schematic, not Princeton geography or field measurements.
Every destination counts equally. The objective counts destinations newly reachable from Arrival court and does not score partial progress, hazard reduction, or people served.
Condition scores are authored visual rankings from 1 (least severe) to 5 (most severe). Evidence review status does not determine route passability.
Costs are assumptions in USD, not contractor estimates. Each repair's amount covers its complete modeled scope, including allocated setup.
Repairs are hypothetical. Each clears a named blocker in the model without changing source evidence or claiming actual work or route outcomes.
